title: Malaysian Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Malaysian-inspired dish featuring chicken, noodles, and hearty vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add sliced onion, bell pepper, and carrots to the skillet. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-5 minutes.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with vegetables.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with noodles and vegetables.
Season with soy sauce, chili flakes, and fish sauce (if using).
Serve hot and garnish with chopped cilantro (if desired).
Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
